messages:
elaine_marketing: Need a micro-battlecard + 30s elevator + 3 one-liners for next week's launch post + webinar. Audience: platform engineers & infra buyers comparing cloud endpoints, LLM APIs, and self-hosted runtimes. Keep it consumable for SDRs.

kai_data: For the benchmark narrative: don't talk raw token %s. Use comparative framing: "Lower cost per effective inference (end-to-end) when using workload-aware serving vs unmanaged cloud endpoints". We can show median cost diff for our reference workload but phrase as "up to" and include workload appendix.

ravi_sales: SDR needs: 2 email subject lines, 2 quick openers, and 3 objection soundbites (lock-in, complexity, TTV). Also want a short competitive cheat: what to say vs cloud AI providers and vs infra vendors.

mira_devrel: Demo plan: start with a live request showing p99 with cloud endpoint vs our hosted vs dedicated with routing enabled. Toggle caching on and show immediate p95 improvement. Script: "step 1: baseline call -> step 2: enable routing+cache -> step 3: show cost delta in console". Keep it under 10 minutes.

kai_data: Suggested conservative phrasing for marketing: "Serve LLMs with predictable SLAs and lower end-to-end inference cost when using serving optimizations". Appendix: table with model, seq len distribution, batch size, quant mode, and routing policy.

ravi_sales: Draft subject lines: 1) "How to cut inference spend for product LLMs" 2) "Get SLA-backed latency for LLM features" Openers: A) "We ran a head-to-head on typical product prompts; here's a short summary you can skim in 60s." B) "Curious how you handle p99 spikes? We route + fallback to keep users happy. 10-min demo?"

elaine_marketing: One-liners for hero: 1) "Production inference, not experiments" 2) "Same API. Predictable latency. Lower cost." 3) "From hosted to on-prem: unified serving." Which reads best?

mira_devrel: I like #2. It's crisp. For the battlecard: include 3 competitor claims and 2 short counters each. Example vs cloud: claim "we manage models for you" -> counter: "We do too + let you pin versions and control rollouts". vs infra vendors: claim "we keep you on-prem" -> counter: "We offer Private deployments + unified ops across modes".

kai_data: Add a technical delta: we expose routing/fallback policies and automatic KV/prefix caching. That's distinct vs generic cloud endpoints that are single-variant and lack prefix cache plumbing.

ravi_sales: Objection handlers (short): Lock-in: "Open model catalog + standard API; you can export configs" Complexity: "Managed defaults + one-click Dedicated trials" TTV: "Hosted API available for quick tests; Dedicated for scale"

ops-bot: Deploy note: adding hidden form field `utm_campaign=fieldops_bench_v3` and `hidden_intent=bench_download`. Emitting GA event `bench_v3_dl` on submit. Deploy window 1765432000-1765432600. Will confirm after push.

elaine_marketing: Landing CTAs: Download summary, Watch the 10-min demo clip, Request Dedicated trial. Thank-you email: short + link to schedule (Calendly) + download.

mira_devrel: For the webinar panel, propose 15-min demo, 20-min customer case, 10-min Q&A. Have a launcher slide with 3 quick wins: predictable latency, routing-based resilience, measurable unit-econ wins.

kai_data: We'll provide two benchmark graphs: latency CDF (p50/p95/p99) and cost-per-request bar chart. Add a small methodology blurb: "standardized gen prompts, avg seq=180, repeated runs, identical VM config when comparing unmanaged endpoints. Results will vary by workload."

ravi_sales: Can we get a 1-paragraph one-pager for SDRs to paste into outreach? Also need 3 quick lines for LinkedIn post.

elaine_marketing: Owners: Elaine -> landing page + one-pager + LinkedIn copy by Fri EOD. Kai -> graphs + methodology by Thu noon. Mira -> demo script + clip by Thu EOD. Ravi -> SDR sequences + subject lines by Fri noon. Ops-bot -> deploy + GA events in window.

elaine_marketing: Final: keep battlecard to a single page, put metrics in an appendix, make SDR copy < 80 words. I'll assemble a playbook and run a 20-min dry run next Mon. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Deploy confirmed at 1765432250. GA event wired.

ravi_sales: Thanks team. I'll schedule SDR playtest.
